meaning:
1) to dig, excavate, dig through, cut
1a) (Qal) to dig

elsewhere.note: He built an altar there, and called on Yahweh’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.
“If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,
the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;
They buried him in his own tomb, which he had dug out for himself in David’s city, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odors and various kinds…
He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
Should evil be recompensed for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from…
